name: grand_challenge-mcp
description: Grand Challenge (competitions): me, discover, get_competition, standings. Every tool maps to a docum

platform_mcp_grand_challenge_api_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GRAND_CHALLENGE_API_TOKEN
platform_mcp_grand_challenge_api_token.description: Personal API token from https://grand-challenge.org/settings/api-tokens/ (sent as Authorization: Bearer).

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /api/v1/profiles/users/self/: user.username, institution, department, location, website.

tools.name: discover
tools.description: GET /api/v1/challenges/ (limit/offset): all public challenges, newest first by server order; no text or status filter, so `query`, `kind` and `status` are not sent. `id` is the slug; `title` can be empty (the slug is the short name). description, incentives, submission_types and publications stay in `raw`.

tools.name: standings
tools.description: GET /api/v1/evaluations/?submission__phase=<phase UUID>: pass the phase UUID (not the challenge slug) as `competition_id`. Returns the evaluations your token may see (published leaderboard entries and your own); `rank` is 0 for unranked rows. Per-metric ranks and outputs stay in `raw`.
